classification.difficultyReason: Identify the factors of six among die faces and calculate the probability of their complement.

content.prompt: A fair six-sided die is rolled. What is the probability of not rolling a factor of 6?

answer.worked:
The factors of 6 on the die are 1, 2, 3 and 6.
$$\begin{align*}P(\text{not a factor of }6)&=1-P(\text{factor of }6)\\P(\text{not a factor of }6)&=1-\frac{4}{6}\\P(\text{not a factor of }6)&=\frac{1}{3}\end{align*}$$
